findings.evidence: Diff lines `change (eK (e (eL x)) : Realization K) = _`, `rw [he]`, `rfl` at the end of `exists_homotopyEquiv_realization`.
findings.fix: Rewrite with the explicit lemmas instead (`ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv.trans_apply`, `Homeomorph.setCongr_apply`, `Homeomorph.Set.univ_apply`, `Topology.IsEmbedding.toHomeomorph_apply_coe`, via `simp only [...]` or `ext`). If that is impossible, add a comment saying why the `change` is required.
findings.issue: `change (eK (e (eL x)) : Realization K) = _` has no comment saying why it is needed. The following `rw [he]; rfl` only works because the coercions of `HomotopyEquiv.trans`, `Homeomorph.toHomotopyEquiv`, `Homeomorph.setCongr`, `Homeomorph.Set.univ` and `IsEmbedding.toHomeomorph` unfold to the right map.

findings.evidence: `refine ⟨.ofDeformationRetraction _ r hr hR.homotopic.symm, ?_⟩; funext x; rw [ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv.ofDeformationRetraction_toFun]; rfl`. Grep shows `ofDeformationRetraction_apply` exists in DeformationRetract.lean:205.
findings.fix: Pass the inclusion explicitly, as `ContinuousMap.inclusion` or a named map. Then close with `ofDeformationRetraction_apply` plus `ContinuousMap.inclusion_apply`/`Subtype.ext`, not with `rfl`.
findings.issue: Same problem in `exists_homotopyEquiv`: after `rw [ofDeformationRetraction_toFun]`, the bare `rfl` depends on the coercion of the continuous map `_` (left for unification) being definitionally `fun x => ⟨x.1, h.le x.2⟩`.

findings.evidence: Lines 116 and 196 both contain `have key : ∀ v : Fin 72, ∃ g ∈ ..., g.testBit v = true := by decide +kernel` followed by the same `obtain`/`exact mem_ofMasks.mpr ⟨Finset.singleton_nonempty v, g, hg, Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (mem_maskFace.mpr hv)⟩`.
findings.fix: Add a lemma to Collapse/Certificate.lean, e.g. `singleton_mem_ofMasks_of_forall_exists_testBit (h : ∀ v : Fin n, ∃ g ∈ G, g.testBit v = true) (v) : {v} ∈ ofMasks n G`. Use it in both places, with `decide +kernel` supplying `h`.
findings.issue: The `singleton_mem` proof of `bingBox` copies `singleton_mem_ofMasks_bingHouseTriangles` (line 113) word for word. The generic fact (if every vertex is a bit of some generator, every singleton is a face of `ofMasks n G`) never gets stated.

summary: In `exists_homotopyEquiv_realization`, an undocumented `change` and a closing `rfl` only work because of how the coercions through `Homeomorph.setCongr`, `IsEmbedding.toHomeomorph`, `Homeomorph.Set.univ` and `HomotopyEquiv.trans` unfold, and `exists_homotopyEquiv` closes the same way. The proof that every vertex is a singleton face appears twice in `BingHouse.lean` and should be one generic certificate lemma.
